steps.title: Initialize Android Project Structure
steps.description: Sets up the basic Android project files including the manifest and build configuration.

steps.title: Define Note Data Model
steps.description: Creates the Note class to represent individual notes with id, title, content, and category.

steps.title: Implement SQLite Database Helper
steps.description: Develops NoteDatabaseHelper for managing SQLite operations like creating, reading, updating, and deleting notes.

steps.title: Create Note List Item Layout
steps.description: Designs the layout for a single note item displayed in the main list.

steps.title: Design Main Activity Layout
steps.description: Configures the main layout for MainActivity, which will display the list of notes.

steps.title: Implement Custom Note Adapter
steps.description: Creates a custom ArrayAdapter to efficiently display Note objects in a ListView.

steps.title: Create Note Detail Activity Layout
steps.description: Designs the layout for NoteDetailActivity, used for adding new notes or editing existing ones.

steps.title: Implement Note Detail Activity
steps.description: Develops NoteDetailActivity for handling note creation, editing, and deletion, interacting with the database.

steps.title: Setup Menu for Main Activity
steps.description: Defines the options menu for MainActivity, including options for adding, searching, and filtering notes.

steps.title: Integrate Database and UI in MainActivity
steps.description: Implements the core logic in MainActivity to fetch and display notes, handle clicks, and refresh the list.

steps.title: Implement Search and Category Filtering
steps.description: Adds functionality to MainActivity to search notes by text and filter by categories using dialogs.

steps.title: Building Notes Categories App
steps.description: The final step to compile and build the Android application.
